evidence.title: GitHub - Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress.

name: Understand Anything
summary: Agent skills that turn any codebase, docs or wiki into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore and question.
description: A nine-skill pack installed with npx skills add. The main /understand command runs a tree-sitter + LLM multi-agent pipeline that extracts every file, function, class and dependency into a knowledge graph JSON and opens an interactive dashboard; companion skills cover dashboards, explanations, chat, onboarding, diffs, business domains, wiki knowledge bases and Figma. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and more.
contains: multi-agent pipeline: 5 agents, 7 for domain and knowledge skills
platform installers for 15 hosts incl. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI
